lines.text: Pip. We need to talk.
Is this about the corn?
It is always about the corn.
I only ate one row.
There were only two rows, Pip.
Gasp. Half the corn.
Gourdon, you are a pumpkin. Stay out of this.
I have been carved. I am open to everything now.
Marigold. You are a scarecrow. I am a crow. Did you think this would be easy?
I thought love would be stronger than corn.
Nothing is stronger than corn.
He is right. I have seen the farmer's face.
I stood in that field for three hundred nights. Arms out. Like this.
And I landed on them. Every single night.
You were supposed to be scared.
You have buttons for eyes, Marigold. They are very nice buttons.
Thank you.
Kiss.
Gourdon.
Sorry. My candle is very emotional tonight.
Fine. I will give back the corn.
How?
You do not want to know.
Then we are finished.
Then I will fly away. Forever.
It is cold out there.
I know.
And that is why they call it a scarecrow. Because the crow was scared. Of being alone.
That is not why they call it that.
Happy Halloween.
